events.verdict: Collison (IND) briefly places his hand on VanVleet's (TOR) back as he spins away but he does not dislodge him as he deflects the ball away.
Turner (IND) absorbs the contact from Brown (TOR) and cleanly blocks the shot attempt.
RAR shows Oladipo (IND) extends his arm slightly, but does not dislodge Brown (TOR) from his defensive position on the drive to the basket.
LAR shows Brown (TOR) maintains legal guarding position and makes incidental contact with Oladipo (IND) that does not affect his SQBR.
RAR shows Siakam (TOR) fails to fully clear the lane and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Brown (TOR) legally contests Oladipo's (IND) jump shot attempt.
Siakam (TOR) is already in Bogdanovic's (IND) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Bogdanovic (IND) legally contests Leonard's (TOR) jump shot attempt.
Anunoby (TOR) cleanly dislodges the ball from Turner (IND).
VanVleet (TOR) and Collison (IND) briefly engage and separate off ball.
Green (TOR) makes marginal contact with Oladipo (IND) that does not affect his SQBR.
Young (IND) does not make contact to Leonard's (TOR) arm and does not affect his ability to pass.
RLB shows Anunoby (TOR) makes a legal move to the basket.
MOB shows Turner (IND) legally contests Anunoby's (TOR) shot near the rim.
Oladipo (IND) does not advance the ball into the frontcourt within eight seconds.
Bogdanovic (IND) maintains legal guarding position and makes incidental contact with Leonard (TOR) that does not affect his SQBR.
Leonard (TOR) moves his pivot foot during his spin move.
Oladipo (IND) legally contests Green's (TOR) jump shot attempt. Any "high-five" contact after the release is considered incidental.
Turner (IND) is already in Green's (TOR) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Green (TOR) puts a hand/forearm to Oladipo's (IND) front during his drive and affects his SQBR.
Oladipo (IND) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
LAR shows VanVleet (TOR) maintains legal guarding position and makes incidental contact with Oladipo (IND) that does not affect his ability to gather.
Oladipo (IND) makes contact to Green's (TOR) arm as they are jumping, and Green is able to play through the contact and tip the ball to his teammate.
Green (TOR) cleanly ties up Oladipo (IND), and a jump ball is correctly called.
This is a correct call that was whistled. McDermott (IND) commits a take foul on Siakam (TOR).
Joseph (IND) commits a take foul on Green (TOR).
LLB and MOB show Anunoby (TOR) makes contact to Bogdanovic's (IND) arm as he is starting his upward shooting motion.
